question: Whether the sign-up form of CloudCruise, CloudBrowser and BrowserCloud takes a card at registration, or only when a paid plan is bought, is unread: each form is behind a login wall (BrowserCloud and CloudBrowser) or renders client-side (CloudCruise). Is the trial gated by a card?
why: a card at sign-up is the difference between qualifies-with-caveat and fails-identity on a trial whose free half is short
